# Correctness verdict: PASS

PR #192 at `ffae78163f60762d894cf9808a623c5091ad018f`, answering `01a1bc54-3438-7ad3-af66-f9cffd433a5a`. No correctness findings.

**Off means no new idle-nudge work.** `idle_nudge::round` checks `Services::idle_nudge` before obtaining the watchdog store, reading holders, building candidate maps, reading compactions or entering delivery (`crates/daemon/src/idle_nudge.rs:62-66`). Returning an empty Vec admits no message, FYI or nudge mark. The surrounding PA watchdog continues its existing unrelated work; this switch does not disable that watchdog.

**Boot wiring and opt-in are correct.** `Config::default` sets the flag false (`crates/core/src/config.rs:218`). The daemon composition root reads only the named environment variable, once, and accepts trimmed, case-insensitive `1`, `on` and `true` (`crates/cli/src/main.rs:2705-2711`); `build_services` copies the boolean into Services (`crates/daemon/src/lib.rs:655`). The enabled round's implementation is otherwise unchanged. All eight existing daemon idle-nudge tests opt in through the shared fixture; the new test leaves Config at its default and verifies no nudge, recipient message or parent FYI for an overdue holder.

**Evidence:** inspected the retained author baseline and mutant outputs: nine tests pass unmutated; ignoring the switch gives eight passes and only `the_nudge_is_off_by_default` fails at its first round-outcome assertion (`idle_nudge_tests.rs:279`). The author reports restoring the backup and committing that unchanged working tree as this head; no reviewer mutant was run. CLI environment spelling/normalization has source proof, not a dedicated integration test.

Exact-head CI run `42507561673`, artifact `13628425612`, contains **2,277 passing Rust cases**, including all nine daemon idle-nudge cases; nextest separately reports five skipped cases. Rust lint, Node 22/24 and delivers passed. `pr-freeze` returned FINAL/CLEAN with matching heads and a clean detached worktree. CI merge `4766081d6be791ec469af14a0a71cf60fd92ea9c` and this head share tree `517d829511761f15c393bdf6609a187904bfcc88`.

**Scope/cost:** the existing 60-second PA-round call remains; when off, the idle-nudge portion is a boolean check and empty return, with no feature-specific reads or sends. When on, #189 behavior remains intentionally unchanged. The flag takes effect at daemon start and does not withdraw messages already queued before deployment. No new loop, poll, timer or launch; no measured savings claim. The PR's intentional absence of a strict `Fixes:` line preserves coder/f144 for part 2. No local reviewer builds/tests, product edits, live-fleet probes, credential reads, merge, push or review-HEAD movement.
